title: [CQ-M07c] Wire the readiness snapshot into assertExecutionProfileReady
description:
Slice of CQ-M07 (task-1a8f1d0e199046a289e94a5453d758b8); M07 DoD 4. Design: mem:decision-cq-m07-verified-local-activation. Depends on CQ-M07b (task-cf952313), the evaluator.

Objective: assertExecutionProfileReady('verified-local') (packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/executionProfile.ts) passes exactly when the daemon's own latest readiness evaluation says ready. Every caller (settings validator, plan submission, claims, completion, delivery policy, qa_approve, rollout activation) follows without per-call-site edits.

Deliverable:
- A leaf-safe holder for the current ReadinessSnapshot. Default: not ready, every capability missing. Only the daemon's evaluator sets it. executionProfile.ts stays a LEAF (runtime imports only util/errors and that holder).
- assertExecutionProfileReady: legacy/observe unchanged. verified-local returns when the held snapshot is ready, else throws the same EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY error with missingCapabilities = the held list and a message naming them.
- packages/moe-daemon/src/state/profileRollout.ts activationGaps(): the vm and check gaps come from the held snapshot instead of constants. The client gap is unchanged until CQ-M07d.
- Daemon startup (packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts): evaluate once at start, then on a bounded interval (the planner picks, e.g. 5 min) with production deps: the store from CQ-M07a, the pinned-client probe, the install-root check, the runner key and the live settings. A failed evaluation leaves the snapshot not ready. Unit tests never evaluate unless they inject.

Compatibility: every existing test that pins the refusal keeps passing unchanged, because the default snapshot is not ready: executionProfile.test.ts, profileRollout.test.ts, __e2e__/rolloutControls.e2e.test.ts, CQ-M06a's benchmarks/rolloutDecision.test.ts and the readiness-mocked strong tests (mem:convention-verified-local-test-fixture).

NOT in scope: the MCP tool, /ws projection and SERVER_CAPABILITIES.verifiedLocal (CQ-M07d); route enforcement on claims (CQ-M07q).

Verification: the FULL daemon vitest suite (a shared readiness contract gets broad regression) in a git-archive snapshot with this task's files overlaid: cd <snapshot>/packages/moe-daemon && npm ci && npm test, under env -i with the nvm Node 24 PATH. Never in the shared checkout.
definitionOfDone: With a held ready snapshot, a settings update to executionProfile 'verified-local' succeeds and a verified-local task can be submitted and claimed; with the default snapshot each of those is refused EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY (vitest through the real tools).
The refusal's missingCapabilities equals the held snapshot's list (vitest).

M07 DoD 4 proof rows: env vars (MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1 and others), settings.executionProfile and deliveryPolicy values, a readiness label persisted in project.json or a task JSON, caller arguments on claim_next_task, submit_plan, settings updates and qa_approve, and a valid report file inside the project or .moe/ each leave verified-local refused (vitest).
activationGaps() lists vm and check only when the held snapshot misses the matching capabilities (vitest).
The daemon start path evaluates and sets the snapshot with injected deps, and a throwing evaluation leaves it not ready (vitest).
The full daemon suite passes in a git-archive snapshot; the completion cites the counts.
taskRails: executionProfile.ts must stay a leaf: no import of delivery/policy.ts or any state store.
